About Me & My Skills:
Hello! I am Abdallah, a developer from Jordan. I recently graduated from high school (Muawiyah bin Abi Sufyan School) and I am the creator of SANAD-Engine, a custom game engine built from scratch using C++23 and Vulkan. I have strong skills in low-level programming, graphics architecture, and building interactive systems. I am deeply passionate about space exploration and creating immersive digital experiences.
